CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG ( BATCH_LOG_SQ INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, BATCH_CD VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, TRIGGER_CD VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, STATUS_CD VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, START_DT DATETIME NOT NULL, END_DT DATETIME NOT NULL, FROM_DT DATE NULL, TO_DT DATE NULL, READ_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, INSERT_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UPDATE_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, SAME_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, EXCL_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, SKIP_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, SKIP_DETAIL TEXT NULL, ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(500) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (BATCH_LOG_SQ), KEY IX_BATCH_LOG_CD (BATCH_CD, START_DT) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
ALTER TABLE TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ICAL_NM VARCHAR(100) NULL AFTER TRIGGER_CD

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG_D ( LOG_D_SQ INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, BATCH_LOG_SQ INT NOT NULL, RESULT_CD VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, INTV_DT DATE NULL, INTV_TM VARCHAR(20) NULL, APLY_NM VARCHAR(100) NULL, INTV_SQ INT NULL, EVT_TITLE VARCHAR(500) NULL, REASON VARCHAR(200) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (LOG_D_SQ), KEY IX_BATCH_LOG_D (BATCH_LOG_SQ) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
ALTER TABLE TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG_D ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS RESUME_NOTE VARCHAR(200) NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ADDR, EDU, AGE, GENDER, CAREER, LANG FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M WHERE INTV_SQ = #{INTV_SQ}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M SET ADDR = COALESCE(NULLIF(ADDR, ''), #{ADDR}) , EDU = COALESCE(NULLIF(EDU, ''), #{EDU}) , AGE = COALESCE(NULLIF(AGE, ''), #{AGE}) , GENDER = COALESCE(NULLIF(GENDER, ''), #{GENDER}) , LANG_NOTE = IF(LANG IS NULL OR LANG = '', #{LANG_NOTE}, LANG_NOTE) , LANG = COALESCE(NULLIF(LANG, ''), #{LANG}) , CAREER = IF(CAREER IS NULL OR CAREER = '' OR CAREER REGEXP '^(신입|경력)( [0-9년개월 ]+| · .*)?$', COALESCE(#{CAREER}, CAREER), CAREER) , UPDT_EMPLY_ID = 'BATCH', UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE INTV_SQ = #{INTV_SQ}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M ( ICAL_SQ INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, ICAL_NM VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, ICAL_URL VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, AUTO_YN CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', REG_DT DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (ICAL_SQ), UNIQUE KEY UX_BATCH_ICAL_URL (ICAL_URL) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M (ICAL_NM, ICAL_URL, AUTO_YN) SELECT '인터뷰 일정', CONF_VAL, 'Y' FROM TB_EEP_CAL_CONF_M WHERE CONF_KEY = 'INTERVIEW_ICAL_URL' AND CONF_VAL <> ''
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS DRIVE_FOLDER_ID VARCHAR(100) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS DRIVE_TOKEN VARCHAR(512) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS DRIVE_ACCOUNT VARCHAR(200) NULL

UPDATE TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M SET DRIVE_FOLDER_ID = (SELECT CONF_VAL FROM TB_EEP_CAL_CONF_M WHERE CONF_KEY = 'DRIVE_RESUME_FOLDER') WHERE DRIVE_FOLDER_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EEP_CAL_CONF_M WHERE CONF_KEY = 'DRIVE_RESUME_FOLDER')
mapper.select: SELECT ICAL_SQ, ICAL_NM, ICAL_URL, AUTO_YN, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DT, DRIVE_FOLDER_ID, DRIVE_TOKEN, DRIVE_ACCOUNT FROM TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M ORDER BY ICAL_SQ
SELECT ICAL_SQ, ICAL_NM, ICAL_URL, DRIVE_FOLDER_ID, DRIVE_TOKEN FROM TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M WHERE AUTO_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ICAL_SQ
SELECT ICAL_SQ, ICAL_NM, ICAL_URL, DRIVE_FOLDER_ID, DRIVE_TOKEN FROM TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M WHERE ICAL_SQ = #{ICAL_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M (ICAL_NM, ICAL_URL, DRIVE_FOLDER_ID) VALUES (#{ICAL_NM}, #{ICAL_URL}, #{DRIVE_FOLDER_ID})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M SET DRIVE_TOKEN = #{DRIVE_TOKEN}, DRIVE_ACCOUNT = #{DRIVE_ACCOUNT} WHERE ICAL_SQ = #{ICAL_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_BATCH_ICAL_M SET AUTO_YN = #{AUTO_YN} WHERE ICAL_SQ = #{ICAL_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT INTV_TM FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M WHERE INTV_DT = #{INTV_DT} AND INTV_TM IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(ATTEND_ST, '') <> 'CANCEL' ORDER BY INTV_TM
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M WHERE INTV_DT = #{INTV_DT} AND INTV_TM = #{INTV_TM} AND IFNULL(ATTEND_ST, '') <> 'CANCEL'
SELECT INTV_SQ, INTV_TM FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M WHERE GCAL_EVT_ID IS NULL AND APLY_NM = #{APLY_NM} AND INTV_DT = #{INTV_DT} ORDER BY INTV_SQ LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M (SEQ_NO, APLY_NM, INTV_DT, INTV_TM, APLY_TARGET, APLY_ROUTE, PHONE, ATTEND_ST, CAREER, RESULT_ST, GCAL_EVT_ID, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO), 0) + 1, #{APLY_NM}, #{INTV_DT}, #{INTV_TM}, #{APLY_TARGET}, #{APLY_ROUTE}, #{PHONE}, #{ATTEND_ST}, #{CAREER}, #{RESULT_ST}, #{GCAL_EVT_ID}, 'BATCH', NOW() FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M SET GCAL_EVT_ID = #{GCAL_EVT_ID}, INTV_DT = #{INTV_DT}, INTV_TM = #{INTV_TM} , APLY_TARGET = COALESCE(NULLIF(APLY_TARGET, ''), #{APLY_TARGET}) , APLY_ROUTE = COALESCE(NULLIF(APLY_ROUTE, ''), #{APLY_ROUTE}) , PHONE = COALESCE(NULLIF(PHONE, ''), #{PHONE}) , ATTEND_ST = COALESCE(NULLIF(ATTEND_ST, ''), #{ATTEND_ST}) , CAREER = COALESCE(NULLIF(CAREER, ''), #{CAREER}) , RESULT_ST = COALESCE(NULLIF(RESULT_ST, ''), #{RESULT_ST}) , UPDT_EMPLY_ID = 'BATCH', UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE INTV_SQ = #{INTV_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG (BATCH_CD, TRIGGER_CD, ICAL_NM, STATUS_CD, START_DT, END_DT, FROM_DT, TO_DT, READ_CNT, INSERT_CNT, UPDATE_CNT, SAME_CNT, EXCL_CNT, SKIP_CNT, ERROR_MSG) VALUES (#{BATCH_CD}, #{TRIGGER_CD}, #{ICAL_NM}, #{STATUS_CD}, #{START_DT}, NOW(), #{FROM_DT}, #{TO_DT}, #{READ_CNT}, #{INSERT_CNT}, #{UPDATE_CNT}, #{SAME_CNT}, #{EXCL_CNT}, #{SKIP_CNT}, #{ERROR_MSG})

INSERT INTO TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG_D (BATCH_LOG_SQ, RESULT_CD, INTV_DT, INTV_TM, APLY_NM, INTV_SQ, EVT_TITLE, REASON, RESUME_NOTE) VALUES
(#{BATCH_LOG_SQ}, #{d.RESULT_CD}, #{d.INTV_DT}, #{d.INTV_TM}, #{d.APLY_NM}, #{d.INTV_SQ}, #{d.EVT_TITLE}, #{d.REASON}, #{d.RESUME_NOTE})
mapper.select: SELECT RESULT_CD, DATE_FORMAT(INTV_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS INTV_DT, INTV_TM, APLY_NM, INTV_SQ, EVT_TITLE, REASON, RESUME_NOTE FROM TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG_D WHERE BATCH_LOG_SQ = #{BATCH_LOG_SQ} ORDER BY FIELD(RESULT_CD, 'SKIP', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'SAME', 'EXCL'), INTV_DT, INTV_TM, LOG_D_SQ

SELECT BATCH_LOG_SQ, TRIGGER_CD, ICAL_NM, STATUS_CD , DATE_FORMAT(START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS START_DT , TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, START_DT, END_DT) AS ELAPSED_SEC , DATE_FORMAT(FROM_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FROM_DT , DATE_FORMAT(TO_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TO_DT , READ_CNT, INSERT_CNT, UPDATE_CNT, SAME_CNT, EXCL_CNT, SKIP_CNT, SKIP_DETAIL, ERROR_MSG FROM TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG WHERE BATCH_CD = #{BATCH_CD} ORDER BY BATCH_LOG_SQ DESC LIMIT 30
